# Cabot Corporation

> Global specialty chemicals and performance materials manufacturer producing carbon blacks, fumed silica, aerogels, and specialty carbons for industrial applications.

Cabot Corporation develops advanced materials including CAB-O-SIL fumed silica, CAB-O-SPERSE dispersions, LUMIRA aerogel additives, and PROPEL carbon blacks for industries ranging from tires and construction to semiconductors and food & beverage. The company operates manufacturing facilities worldwide and serves markets in automotive, energy, electronics, and consumer products.

## Key Topics

- Fumed Silica
- Fumed Metal Oxides
- Carbon Black
- Aerogel
- CAB-O-SIL
- CAB-O-SPERSE
- LUMIRA
- Hydrophobic Fumed Silica
- Hydrophilic Fumed Silica
- Performance Additives
- Thermal Insulation
- Reinforcing Composites
- Specialty Carbons
- Chemical Mechanical Planarization
- Compression Pack

## Fumed Metal Oxides & Silica Products

- [Hydrophobic Fumed Silica | Cabot Corporation](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/products-plus/fumed-metal-oxides/hydrophobic): CAB-O-SIL hydrophobic fumed silica for coatings & adhesives
- [Fumed Silica & Alumina Dispersions | Cabot Corporation](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/products-plus/fumed-metal-oxides/fumed-silica-and-alumina-dispersions): CAB-O-SPERSE water-based fumed silica & alumina dispersions
- [Colloidal & Composite Silicas | Cabot Corporation](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/products-plus/fumed-metal-oxides/collodial-and-composite-silicas): CAB-O-SIL TG-C & ATLAS colloidal silica for toner applications

## Industrial Applications

- [Construction](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/applications/construction): Building materials with aerogel, fumed silica & LUMIRA additives
- [Reinforcing Composites | Cabot Corporation](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/applications/construction/reinforcing-composites): Fumed silica for fiber-reinforced construction composites
- [Subsea Pipelines | Cabot Corporation](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/applications/oil-gas-and-mining/subsea-pipelines): Aerogel thermal insulation solutions for subsea oil & gas pipelines
- [Industrial Rubber](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/applications/oil-gas-and-mining/industrial-rubber): E2C solutions for abrasion-resistant mining rubber products
- [Efficiency | Cabot Corporation](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/applications/tires/efficiency): PROPEL E Series carbon blacks for low rolling resistance tires

## Adhesives & Coatings

- [Pressure Sensitive | Cabot Corporation](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/applications/adhesives-and-sealants/pressure-sensitive): CAB-O-SPERSE fumed oxides for pressure-sensitive adhesive films

## Electronics & Semiconductor

- [Chemical Mechanical Planarization | Cabot Corporation](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/applications/digitalization/chemical-mechanical-planarization): Fumed silica abrasives for semiconductor CMP wafer polishing

## Food & Beverage Solutions

- [Food & Beverage](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/applications/food-and-beverage): Food-grade fumed silica additives for taste, storage & pouring
- [Performance Additives | Cabot Corporation](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/applications/food-and-beverage/performance-additives): CAB-O-SIL food-grade fumed silica for anti-caking & thickening
- [Specialty Carbons For Food Contact | Cabot Corporation](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/products-plus/specialty-carbons/for-food-contact): FDA & EU compliant specialty carbons for food contact plastics
